title: Spark Guide: compact tile tour + progressive empty-state visuals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact, tile-based first-run tour called 'Spark Guide' for the Redwood Console. The guide should surface a minimal checklist, contextual microtips, and progressively revealing empty states so new users can get productive within 5 minutes. Deliverables: Figma tiles (3 breakpoints), high-fidelity PNG/JPEG screenshots for marketing and docs, annotated specs for engineering (animation timings, ARIA labels), and a small set of microcopy variants for A/B testing. Focus on compactness for users with many routes and on-screen density (teams that onboard multiple models/routes). Avoid reusing existing onboarding illustrations — create a distinct visual motif (modular spark tiles with subtle elevation and carbon-gray accents).
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains 3 responsive variants (mobile, tablet, desktop) and an interactive prototype for the 3-step Spark Guide
Engineering has annotated specs (spacing, tokens, accessible color contrast) and exported assets in the design handoff board
Empty-state flows show progressive reveal: initial card CTA -> contextual hint -> full checklist, with screenshots for each stage
Microcopy has 3 variants and is included in the content package for QA and analytics tagging
progress_updates: 2026-02-21: Kickoff with PM and engineering. Agreed scope: 3 tiles, 3 empty-state stages, microcopy variants
2026-02-25: First Figma pass uploaded. Focused on tile density and keyboard focus states. Asked eng for preferred export formats
2026-03-02: Accessibility review session — increased text contrast on secondary labels and added explicit focus ring specs
2026-03-08: Usability quick test with 6 internal users. Observed confusion around 'Add model' CTA placement; moved CTA to top-right of checklist tile
review_feedback: PM (S. Rodriguez): Likes compact layout; requested stronger signal for required vs optional steps
Engineering (K. Nguyen): Prefer SVGs for icons and noted animation budget constraints on low-powered instances; asked for a static fallback
Design lead (M. Cohen): Suggests reducing tile shadow and increasing spacing to match Console density tokens
Accessibility (J. Martinez): Confirmed keyboard flow but asked to include ARIA-live region for the progressive empty-state changes
decisions: Use a 3-tier progressive empty-state pattern: teaser -> hint -> full checklist
Provide Lottie animation for high-end clients, with CSS keyframe fallback for others
Export icons as monochrome SVGs plus two PNG sizes for docs and marketing
Adopt Console spacing tokens (space-2, space-4, space-8) and color tokens to ensure consistency
next_steps: Finalize microcopy variants and tag with analytics event names
Create engineering handoff board with exported assets and spec sheet (target 2026-03-12)
Prepare marketing-ready screenshots (desktop + mobile) and compress for CDN delivery
Run a short external beta with 10 customers after engineering implements static fallback
notes: Avoid reusing previous onboarding illustrations; new motif must be neutral and modular
Coordinate with Product Marketing for screenshot captions and alt text
Consider a follow-up ticket for localization review after initial launch
